_about: Camera angles for the twin-speaker screen room (void-pair). Robert picked these on 2026-11-12; framed to the rule of thirds with frame_check.py (no guessing). multicam.mjs renders them side by side, in this order.

angles.name: three-quarter
angles._framing: right speaker's woofers on the right third line, left speaker whole on the left third, both fully in frame

angles.name: cones
angles._framing: the two woofers on the left third line at its upper and lower crossings, mid and tweeter on the right third

angles.name: close-low
angles._framing: whole cabinet in frame, its top on the upper third line, mid and tweeter on the right third
